text: Bitcoin is outpacing Ethereum's gains while holding near $86k, signaling stronger conviction in the larger asset despite both majors moving modestly higher. The Fear & Greed index at 78 shows retail and market participants are in extreme greed territory, having jumped 9 points over a week—a condition that historically has preceded pullbacks or consolidation. Bitcoin dominance at 58.9% and $139B in daily volume indicate steady but not euphoric participation, suggesting the market is extended but not yet showing panic-sell dynamics.
